entries.text: A new species, the Lamera, branched off the Lameza.
A new species, the Lameda, branched off the Lameza.
The Lameza are dwindling: from 133 to 52 in 30 days.
8 Tobeta arrived from across the sea.
The Lamebi are gone, after 25 days on the island.
The Lamenu are thriving: from 11 to 65 in 30 days.
The Lamebe are thriving: from 11 to 23 in 30 days.
Among the Lamenu, a group grew apart: the Lamefi.
